## Goal
A short plain-language page for the helper: what the setup file is, what goes into it (name, addresses, phones, emails, relatives) and what never does (the signed consent, the removal mailbox, any password), how to choose and share the passphrase, how to send the file, and what the relative will see. Written for a helper who is not technical and may be on the phone with the relative.

## Blocked: what in-house must provide first
In-house must ship the "Set it up for someone else" screens in the app (ROADMAP 0.4 order item 1; helper side: pick the person, enter their details, choose a passphrase, save the file) and say so in a GO message with the exact button and heading labels and their file:line in `src/freemyid/wizard/`. Also needed: the decision on how the passphrase is shared with the relative (in person or by phone, never in the same message as the file) and on the passphrase rules (WO-506's in-house part). Until then every sentence about a screen would be a guess.

Not startable by a vendor. In-house unblocks it by changing the status line and posting a GO.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Under 700 words, short sentences, reading level grade 8 or lower, numbered steps, one action per step.
2. Every button, heading and message quoted exists in the app; cite file:line in an HTML comment next to each (from the in-house GO).
3. States clearly that the relative still gives their own consent and sets up their own removal mailbox on their own computer; the helper never signs for them (consistent with `docs/user/HELPING.md`, "It is their choice").
4. Says what is inside the file in the same words as `bundle_plan_lines` (WO-502) so the page and the app agree.
5. No "guarantee", "erase", "100%", "nothing is sent"; uses "requested" and "confirmed".
6. Linked from `docs/user/help-topics.md` by in-house after merge (note it in VENDOR_STATUS.md; do not edit that file) and from `docs/user/HELPING.md` the same way.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.
